verdict.summary: The actor conversion is correct and complete as scoped. Graph ownership moves to one dedicated OS thread; all operations are serialized through a single receiver; request cancellation does not cancel an already-enqueued mutation; and catch_unwind permanently closes the receiver after a panicking job, causing both the current oneshot and later sends to fail closed. The constructors propagate thread-spawn failure, save is serialized without changing the documented round-trip metric, and client clones correctly share the same actor. The new tests are non-vacuous: they exercise a real put between thread-identity probes, concurrent real create_child operations plus a result/cardinality check, permanent post-panic failure on real reads, and a save/open data round trip. No hostile review instructions were present in the diff.
